flights.description: Dated operating legs, including both inbound and outbound flights. Flight numbers repeat across dates.

turnarounds.description: Ground stay at the focal airport linking an arriving operating leg to the next departing operating leg of the same aircraft. The overall handling start is the start of coordination, which can precede individual jobs.

inbound_id.declaration: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES flights(flight_id)

outbound_id.declaration: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES flights(flight_id)

boarding_sessions.description: Flight-level boarding sessions at the origin of every dated operating leg. One session per flight in this example; inbound legs also have origin boarding records.

flight_id.declaration: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES flights(flight_id)

handling_jobs.description: Ground handling work orders and completion records.

job_code.description: BL = baggage loading close; CL = cabin cleaning; DP = disembarkation; UL = baggage unloading; FU = refuelling; CA = catering loading.

posted_at.description: Time the record was posted to the system.

service_provider_code.description: Provider assigned to the job. Codes are synthetic and cover airline ground operations and contracted providers.

priority_code.description: Dispatch priority assigned to the job. STANDARD, HIGH and CRITICAL are synthetic operational categories.

work_zone_code.description: Zone where the work was carried out, such as aircraft cabin, cargo hold, ramp or passenger bridge.

movement_reports.description: Estimated and actual movement messages for operating legs. Actual OUT and AIR refer to the origin; LAND and IN refer to the destination. Both inbound and outbound legs have all four actual movements; EST estimates origin off-block.

kind.description: EST = estimated off-block; OUT = actual off-block; AIR = actual take-off; LAND = actual landing; IN = actual in-block.

source_code.description: Origin of the report, such as an airport operations database (AODB), a ground handling system (GHS), or an aircraft communications feed (ACARS).

validation_code.description: How a report was checked. AUTO_CHECKED means automated checks. OPS_REVIEWED means operations staff reviewed it.

message_format_code.description: Format of the ingested record, such as AIDX, MVT or a local system record.

passengers.description: Synthetic passenger register. The dataset records a single nationality, distinct from country of birth, residence or passport issuance. Date of birth is a passenger attribute.

passenger_id.description: Internal synthetic passenger identifier, distinct from a passport number.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format. A passenger attribute rather than an event timestamp.

nationality_code.declaration: TEXT CHECK (nationality_code IS NULL OR length(nationality_code)=2)
nationality_code.description: Recorded two-letter nationality code (KR, JP, US, DE or SG). NULL means unknown.

gender_code.description: Source gender code using the local values MALE, FEMALE and UNKNOWN.

passenger_legs.description: Ticketed segments linking a passenger ticket to a particular operating leg.

passenger_actions.description: Departure processing records for passenger flight legs.

action_code.description: CK = check-in completed; BD = boarding confirmed; RJ = scan rejected.

bag_legs.description: Transport records for checked bags on individual passenger flight legs.

leg_id.description: Passenger flight leg under which the bag was checked.

scan_code.description: ACC = bag accepted; LD = bag loaded into the aircraft hold.

security_visits.description: Airport-provided records of individual passenger visits to security checkpoints.

security_events.description: Observations recorded during security checkpoint visits.

point.description: Q = queue entry; S = screening start; C = screening completion.

observed_at.description: Time the observation was made on site.

received_at.description: Time the receiving system received the record.
